title: Glossary (Plain-English)
description: Short definitions in plain English. For official local guides and directories, use the canonical domains.

terms.def: A fee where a lawyer is paid from the money you recover (settlement or verdict). You should get the percentage and costs in writing.
A rule that can reduce your recovery if you were partly at fault. The exact rule depends on your state.
A dental treatment that removes infected tissue inside a tooth and seals it to reduce pain and save the tooth.
Dental care with medication to reduce anxiety or pain. Ask what type is used and how you’ll be monitored.
A hormone involved in energy, mood, sex drive, and muscle. TRT is medical treatment and should be monitored with labs.
A set of tests and interviews that measure thinking skills and help explain attention, memory, learning, or brain injury concerns.
A doctor authorized to perform USCIS immigration medical exams and complete the I-693 form.
The USCIS medical form used for immigration processes. It usually must be completed by a civil surgeon.
